meta.name: Phase 0 region manifest
meta.description: Direct translation of experiments/assets/region_manifest.json (issue #2's hand-authored Phase 0 test city) into the v1 project format: proves the format expresses a real, already-built asset set. Mirrors that manifest 1:1 (30 regions, 26 types); no lines, points, or labels were authored for it.
